key.name: device-id
key.description: UUID generated on first run. Used in the Jellyfin Authorization header so the server can differentiate this client from other devices.

key.name: last-server-address
key.summary: Cached base URL of the last server

key.name: max-bitrate-wifi
key.summary: Max streaming bitrate (bps) on Wi-Fi; 0 = unlimited

key.name: replaygain
key.summary: Apply ReplayGain when tags are present

key.name: cover-art-theming
key.summary: Tint the Now Playing page with the cover's dominant colour

key.name: autoplay-radio
key.summary: Keep playing similar music when the queue ends
key.description: When the last queued track starts, seed an Instant Mix from it and append the result, so playback continues instead of stopping.

key.name: queue-track-ids
key.summary: Item ids of the last play queue
key.description: Restored at startup so closing the app doesn't lose your place. Ids only — the metadata is re-fetched from the server.

key.name: queue-index
key.summary: Play head within the restored queue

key.name: queue-position
key.summary: Position in seconds within the restored track

key.name: crossfade-seconds
key.summary: Crossfade length in seconds; 0 disables crossfading
key.description: Length of the overlap between one track and the next. 0 keeps the gapless handoff, which is also used within an album unless crossfade-albums is set.

key.name: crossfade-albums
key.summary: Crossfade between consecutive tracks of the same album
key.description: Off by default: album sequencing is usually deliberate, so tracks from one album stay gapless even when crossfading is enabled.

key.name: sleep-timer-default-minutes
key.summary: Default sleep timer duration in minutes

key.name: equalizer-bands
key.summary: Per-band equalizer gains for the 10-band equaliser
